title: Measure a disposable index
brief: Create an index, observe the access path, then remove the index.
instructions: Create one non-unique index on lookup_orders(customer_id) in the disposable sandbox.
Use the main query to return order_id and amount for customer_id = 42.
Report index, sequential, or not-reported from the measured scan profile.
Drop the same index after the probe.
The catalog must contain the requested index after CREATE and no index after DROP.
The complete probe result must agree before CREATE, after CREATE, and after DROP.
An index scan is not required for completion.
starterSql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount FROM lookup_orders LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: The starter shows lookup rows without the requested filter. The CREATE and DROP fields share this disposable session, not the learning database.

hints.text: An index is a separate database object, not a change to source rows.
Create an index on the customer lookup key, run the exact probe, then drop that index.
A small lookup can still use a sequential scan. Completion requires the measured access report and an empty final index catalog.
